role: External technical replication and held-frame prediction, not biological ground-truth validation
cohort: All 20 PET scans from the 10 subjects in ds004868 public S3 listing recorded in s3_objects.json; no outcome-based exclusion
source_identity: PET files must match SHA256 annex hashes in GitHub commit 623ea3de909abd9472538f8e45cf286e1c792444 despite renamed subjects; current blood/metadata separately hashed
immutable_core: Installed petkin 0.3.0rc1; no algorithm or research-screen threshold changes
roi: Largest connected component of duration-weighted training-frame mean exceeding 35% of maximum; one binary erosion; exploratory uptake ROI, not anatomical brain segmentation
held_frames: Zero-based frame indices with index modulo 5 equal to 4; excluded from ROI definition and fitting
input: Seconds to minutes, plasma times supplied parent fraction; linear interpolation between product samples; zero concentration at injection; terminal hold to cover 90 min and delay; no additional dispersion or recovery correction
units: Bq/mL; accept source BQML alias explicitly with no numeric scaling
primary_model: Reversible 2t; vb=.05 fixed; delay=0 fixed; dt=.025 min; eight multistarts seed=0; sigma=sqrt(max(activity,1)/duration); relative weights only
secondary_model: Same model with delay fitted in [-.5,.5] min; all cases reported, not automatic selection
graphical: Logan and MA1 at fixed tstar=30 min and sensitivity 20,40 min; unweighted; vb=.05; no fitted-delay graphical selection
comparators: Unmodified pinned kinfitr Logan/MA1 functions using same processed input; input sampled on .001-min grid for reference; preserve source-method integration differences
metrics: Every scan's held-frame NRMSE, local QC, full-fit macroprofile, method disagreement, four subject-level symmetric test-retest differences. All failures retained
claim_limits: No documented independent cross-calibration or blood decay-reference certificate
Uptake ROI is not anatomical brain segmentation
No motion correction in this kinetic-only experiment
New external evidence alone cannot close EXT-01 or REG-02
research_release: Run unchanged research screen; calibration_matched, decay_reference_matched, input_tissue_timing_verified, and ROI_geometry_verified remain false pending independent review. No parameter released for research use by this experiment
